name: Crossy road
detail: Crossy Road passed native browser gameplay and responsive iPad emulation checks.

quality.evidence: Played the native Three.js build with touch controls through a traffic collision and retried to a fresh score-zero session without runtime errors. The final verifier measured 2487 ms cold and 4102 ms warm; landscape and portrait iPad emulation both rendered the responsive canvas. Screenshots: .game-addition-qa/crossy-road-game-over.png, .game-addition-qa/landscape.png, and .game-addition-qa/portrait.png. Emulation is not a physical iPad test.
